objective: Customers can pay part of an order with a gift card: the backend redeems the card's balance and the frontend shows the amount applied
constraints: money stays in integer minor units with an ISO-4217 currency (DECISIONS.md ADR-001); never a float
the frontend reaches the backend only through shared/src/api.ts (ADR-002); the frontend task owns the contract change
outcomes: a checkout that names a gift card pays as much of its total as the card's balance covers, and no more
the checkout page shows the amount the gift card paid, and nothing when no card was used
the project's own tests pass in each task's worktree: node --test "**/test/*.test.ts"
summary: Carry a gift card through the shared contract and show the amount applied in the frontend; redeem the card's balance in the checkout service. The two tasks have disjoint write scopes and no dependency on each other, so they run in parallel.
rationale: The contract change is small and belongs to the frontend task, which already writes shared/src/api.ts. The backend task adds a self-contained redemption module beside the checkout service and reads the contract without changing it, so neither task waits for the other.

tasks.summary: A gift card in the shared contract, and the amount applied on the checkout page
tasks.description: In shared/src/api.ts, add an optional `giftCard` field to CheckoutRequest, typed `{ code: string }`, and an optional `giftCardApplied` field of type Money to CheckoutResponse, each with a one-line doc comment; keep every existing export as it is. Add frontend/src/gift-card.ts exporting `giftCardLine(applied: Money | undefined): string | null`: it returns null when `applied` is undefined or its amount is 0, and otherwise the text 'Gift card: -' followed by formatPrice(applied) from frontend/src/format-price.ts (so { amount: 1250, currency: 'EUR' } gives 'Gift card: -12.50 EUR'). Add frontend/test/gift-card.test.ts with node:test and node:assert/strict tests for both cases. Import types from '../../shared/src/api.ts' with the .ts extension, as the existing files do. Run the project's tests with `node --test "**/test/*.test.ts"` and make them pass. Do not change any file under backend/.
acceptance_criteria: the gift-card line shows the amount applied, and is absent when no gift card was applied

tasks.summary: Redeem a gift card's balance against the checkout total in the checkout service
tasks.description: Add backend/src/gift-card.ts exporting `redeemGiftCard(total: Money, card: { code: string; balance: Money }): { total: Money; applied: Money }`. It pays as much of the total as the card's balance covers: `applied.amount` is the smaller of the balance and the total, never negative, and the returned total is the original total minus the amount applied, both in the total's currency. A card whose currency differs from the total's throws CheckoutError from backend/src/checkout.service.ts. Amounts are integers in minor units (DECISIONS.md ADR-001). Add backend/test/gift-card.test.ts with node:test and node:assert/strict tests: a card that covers part of the total, a card whose balance exceeds the total (the total goes to 0 and only the total is applied), and a currency mismatch. Import types from '../../shared/src/api.ts' with the .ts extension, as the existing files do, and do not change shared/src/api.ts: the frontend task owns the contract change. Run the project's tests with `node --test "**/test/*.test.ts"` and make them pass. Do not change any file under frontend/ or shared/.
acceptance_criteria: the amount applied never exceeds the card's balance or the order total
